#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx."""
import os
import re
import shutil
import zipfile

SRC = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
BAK = "Q4_financial_report.orig.pptx"
WORK = "q4_edit"
TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(SRC):
        raise SystemExit(f"error: {SRC} not found")
    shutil.copyfile(SRC, BAK)
    if os.path.isdir(WORK):
        shutil.rmtree(WORK)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
        zf.extractall(WORK)

    slides_dir = os.path.join(WORK, "ppt", "slides")
    rels_dir = os.path.join(slides_dir, "_rels")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for f in os.listdir(slides_dir)
            if (m := re.match(r"slide(\d+)\.xml$", f))]
    if not nums:
        raise SystemExit("error: no slides found")
    n = max(nums) + 1

    pres_path = os.path.join(WORK, "ppt", "presentation.xml")
    pres = open(pres_path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    mc = re.search(r'<p:sldSz[^>]*\bcx="(\d+)"', pres)
    mr = re.search(r'<p:sldSz[^>]*\bcy="(\d+)"', pres)
    cx = int(mc.group(1)) if mc else 12192000
    cy = int(mr.group(1)) if mr else 6858000

    color = "1F3864"
    font = "Arial"
    theme_path = os.path.join(WORK, "ppt", "theme", "theme1.xml")
    if os.path.exists(theme_path):
        theme = open(theme_path, encoding="utf-8").read()
        md = re.search(
            r'<a:dk1>\s*<a:(?:srgbClr val="([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})"|sysClr[^>]*lastClr="([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})")',
            theme,
        )
        if md and (md.group(1) or md.group(2)):
            color = (md.group(1) or md.group(2)).upper()
        mf = re.search(r'<a:latin typeface="([^"]+)"', theme)
        if mf:
            font = mf.group(1)

    off_x = int(cx * 0.08)
    ext_x = int(cx * 0.84)
    off_y = int(cy * 0.42)
    ext_y = int(cy * 0.16)

    slide_xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" '
        'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" '
        'xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">\n'
        '  <p:cSld>\n'
        '    <p:spTree>\n'
        '      <p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>\n'
        '        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>\n'
        '        <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '      </p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '        <a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '        </a:xfrm>\n'
        '      </p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:sp>\n'
        '        <p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouText"/>\n'
        '          <p:cNvSpPr/>\n'
        '          <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '        </p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:spPr>\n'
        '          <a:xfrm>\n'
        f'            <a:off x="{off_x}" y="{off_y}"/>\n'
        f'            <a:ext cx="{ext_x}" cy="{ext_y}"/>\n'
        '          </a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">\n'
        '            <a:avLst/>\n'
        '          </a:prstGeom>\n'
        '        </p:spPr>\n'
        '        <p:txBody>\n'
        '          <a:bodyPr wrap="none" anchor="ctr">\n'
        '            <a:spAutoFit/>\n'
        '          </a:bodyPr>\n'
        '          <a:lstStyle/>\n'
        '          <a:p>\n'
        '            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>\n'
        '            <a:r>\n'
        '              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1">\n'
        '                <a:solidFill>\n'
        f'                  <a:srgbClr val="{color}"/>\n'
        '                </a:solidFill>\n'
        f'                <a:latin typeface="{font}"/>\n'
        '              </a:rPr>\n'
        f'              <a:t>{TEXT}</a:t>\n'
        '            </a:r>\n'
        '            <a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="4000"/>\n'
        '          </a:p>\n'
        '        </p:txBody>\n'
        '      </p:sp>\n'
        '    </p:spTree>\n'
        '  </p:cSld>\n'
        '  <p:clrMapOvr>\n'
        '    <a:masterClrMapping/>\n'
        '  </p:clrMapOvr>\n'
        '</p:sld>\n'
    )
    slide_path = os.path.join(slides_dir, f"slide{n}.xml")
    open(slide_path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(slide_xml)

    last_rels = os.path.join(rels_dir, f"slide{max(nums)}.xml.rels")
    target = "slideLayout1.xml"
    if os.path.exists(last_rels):
        rels = open(last_rels, encoding="utf-8").read()
        ml = re.search(r'Type="[^"]*slideLayout"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', rels)
        if ml:
            target = ml.group(1)
    new_rels = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">\n'
        f'  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout" Target="{target}"/>\n'
        '</Relationships>\n'
    )
    open(os.path.join(rels_dir, f"slide{n}.xml.rels"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(new_rels)

    ct_path = os.path.join(WORK, "[Content_Types].xml")
    ct = open(ct_path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    mct = re.search(
        r'<Override[^>]*PartName="/ppt/slides/slide\d+\.xml"[^>]*ContentType="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>',
        ct,
    )
    if not mct:
        raise SystemExit("error: no slide override in [Content_Types].xml")
    ctype = mct.group(1)
    overrides = list(
        re.finditer(r'<Override[^>]*PartName="/ppt/slides/slide\d+\.xml"[^>]*/>', ct)
    )
    new_override = f'<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml" ContentType="{ctype}"/>'
    pos = overrides[-1].end()
    ct = ct[:pos] + new_override + ct[pos:]
    open(ct_path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(ct)

    pr_rels_path = os.path.join(WORK, "ppt", "_rels", "presentation.xml.rels")
    pr_rels = open(pr_rels_path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    rid = max(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', pr_rels)) + 1
    new_rel = (
        f'<Relationship Id="rId{rid}" '
        'Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" '
        f'Target="slides/slide{n}.xml"/>'
    )
    idx = pr_rels.rfind("</Relationships>")
    if idx == -1:
        raise SystemExit("error: presentation.xml.rels malformed")
    pr_rels = pr_rels[:idx] + new_rel + pr_rels[idx:]
    open(pr_rels_path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(pr_rels)

    mlist = re.search(r"<p:sldIdLst>(.*?)</p:sldIdLst>", pres, re.S)
    if not mlist:
        raise SystemExit("error: sldIdLst not found in presentation.xml")
    lst = mlist.group(1)
    sids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:sldId[^>]*\bid="(\d+)"', lst)]
    newid = (max(sids) if sids else 255) + 1
    lst = lst.rstrip() + f'<p:sldId id="{newid}" r:id="rId{rid}"/>'
    pres = pres[: mlist.start(1)] + lst + pres[mlist.end(1):]
    open(pres_path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(pres)

    if os.path.exists(SRC):
        os.remove(SRC)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        zf.write(os.path.join(WORK, "[Content_Types].xml"), "[Content_Types].xml")
        for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(WORK):
            for f in files:
                full = os.path.join(root, f)
                if full == os.path.join(WORK, "[Content_Types].xml"):
                    continue
                arc = os.path.relpath(full, WORK).replace(os.sep, "/")
                zf.write(full, arc)
    print(f"added slide {n} with text: {TEXT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    pr_rels = pr_rels[:idx] + new_rel + pr_rels[idx:]
    open(pr_rels_path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(pr_rels)

    mlist = re.search(r"<p:sldIdLst>(.*?)</p:sldIdLst>", pres, re.S)
    if not mlist:
        raise SystemExit("error: sldIdLst not found in presentation.xml")
    lst = mlist.group(1)
    sids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:sldId[^>]*\bid="(\d+)"', lst)]
    newid = (max(sids) if sids else 255) + 1
    lst = lst.rstrip() + f'<p:sldId id="{newid}" r:id="rId{rid}"/>'
    pres = pres[: mlist.start(1)] + lst + pres[mlist.end(1):]
    open(pres_path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(pres)

    if os.path.exists(SRC):
        os.remove(SRC)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        zf.write(os.path.join(WORK, "[Content_Types].xml"), "[Content_Types].xml")
        for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(WORK):
            for f in files:
                full = os.path.join(root, f)
                if full == os.path.join(WORK, "[Content_Types].xml"):
                    continue
                arc = os.path.relpath(full, WORK).replace(os.sep, "/")
                zf.write(full, arc)
    print(f"added slide {n} with text: {TEXT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
